## Deal checklist

- [ ] The entry has been added to `data/deals.csv`.
- [ ] The official product or offer URL is included.
- [ ] Regular and sale prices are explicit, with currency.
- [ ] Coupon code or `NO_CODE` is included.
- [ ] Start/end dates and timezone are included.
- [ ] Eligibility and renewal terms are included.
- [ ] The offer was checked against the official vendor source.
